shared_elements: human figure holding/raising an elongated object (weapon or staff)
figures shown with schematic linear body detail
justification: Both surfaces show human figures in profile-oriented poses, and both include an elongated linear object held or raised by an arm plus small disc-like marks, but these are near-universal motifs. Otherwise the content diverges sharply: A shows a crowded group of bearded, elaborately coiffed and robed figures rendered in dense naturalistic detail with patterned beards and headgear, while B shows a single stick-like silhouette figure brandishing a spear amid isolated schematic hooks, boat-like signs and dots, with utterly different proportions and rendering conventions.
